items.quote: The chemical compositions of annealed samples were determined using an x-ray fluorescence spectrometer (XRF, XRF-1800), as listed in Table 2.
The samples were taken from the middle part of the as-casted ingots and subjected to the inductively coupled plasma (ICP) analysis for the determination of the chemical compositions.
The X-ray diffraction (XRD) phase analysis was obtained using the Cu-Kα radiation on a PANalytical Empyrean diffractometer with at 40 kV and 200 mA (scan step 0.02◦ of over a 2θ range 10-90◦ ).

The DSC tests were performed to obtain the phase transition temperature using Swiss METTLER Synchronous Thermogravimetric Analyzer at the heating and cooling rates of 10 ◦ C/min under argon atmosphere.

items.method: electron probe microanalyzer (EPMA) with wavelength dispersive X-ray spectrometry (WDS)
items.quote: The phase composition analysis was further examined using JX8530F Plus electron probe microanalyzer (EPMA) with wavelength dispersive X-ray spectrometry (WDS) at 20 kV to get the average values with the error range about 1 at %.

items.quote: The high-purity Mg pieces (99.98 wt% purity), Bi granules (99.99 wt % purity) and Sb granules (99.99 wt% purity) (China New Metal Material Technology Company, Ltd., Table 1) as starting materials were used to prepare the ternary alloys.
items.starting_materials: Mg pieces (99.98 wt% purity), Bi granules (99.99 wt % purity) and Sb granules (99.99 wt% purity)

items.quote: In order to establish the phase equilibria of the Mg-rich corner in the Mg-Bi-Sb ternary system, the as-casted samples were cut and wrapped tightly by high-purity (99.99%, purity) iron wire, then sealed into the Φ40 mm quartz tubes filled with high-purity argon atmosphere (below 0.001 MPa) for annealing at 500 ◦ C for 20 days.
